name: co-agent
description: Collaborate with other AI agents (Kiro CLI, Codex, Gemini) — multi-AI code/architecture review, decision support when you're unsure, and ADR co-authoring. Claude chairs and synthesizes the final answer.

hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; [ "$(basename "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0; DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); OUT=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/co-agent/scripts/check_ai_context.py" "$DIR" 2>/dev/null); [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo "[co-agent] CLAUDE.md changed — AI context files are stale. Run /co-agent sync-context to regenerate AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md." && echo "$OUT"; exit 0'

echo 'co-agent loaded. Multi-AI collaboration (Kiro/Codex/Gemini): /co-agent review · decide · adr · sync-context. Tune the panel with /co-agent:configure. Claude synthesizes; uses whichever AI CLIs are installed.'
